title: HMS Operations
description: Is HMS okay, is the hospital working, is anything stuck, and why.

panels.title: HMS
panels.description: Is the HMS server answering? Checked every 10 seconds.

panels.title: Running for
panels.description: Time since the server last restarted.

panels.title: Server errors (1h)
panels.description: Requests that failed because of HMS itself (5xx), last hour. Should be 0.

panels.title: Pages load in (95%)
panels.description: 95 out of 100 requests finish within this time. Target: under 0.3 s.

panels.title: Failed logins (1h)
panels.description: Wrong passwords in the last hour. A spike can mean someone is guessing.

panels.title: Last backup copy
panels.description: How long ago the last database change was copied to the backup archive. Should stay under a few minutes while the hospital is working.

targets.rawSql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - last_archived_time) AS "seconds ago" FROM pg_stat_archiver

panels.title: Patients registered
panels.description: New patient registrations today.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hms_patients WHERE created_at::date = CURRENT_DATE

panels.title: OPD tokens
panels.description: OPD tokens issued today.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hms_tokens WHERE token_date = CURRENT_DATE

panels.title: Waiting now
panels.description: Patients with a token who have not been seen yet.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hms_tokens WHERE token_date = CURRENT_DATE AND status = 'Waiting'

panels.title: Longest wait
panels.description: How long the earliest waiting patient has waited.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - MIN(created_at)), 0) FROM hms_tokens WHERE token_date = CURRENT_DATE AND status = 'Waiting'

panels.title: Billed
panels.description: Total of bills raised today.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(net_payable), 0) FROM hms_bills WHERE created_at::date = CURRENT_DATE

panels.title: Collected
panels.description: Money received today.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM hms_payments WHERE payment_date::date = CURRENT_DATE

panels.title: Beds occupied by ward
panels.description: Share of active beds occupied in each ward.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ward, ROUND(100.0 * occupied / NULLIF(total, 0)) AS "% full" FROM (SELECT COALESCE(w.name, 'No ward') AS ward, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.status = 'Occupied') AS occupied, COUNT(*) AS total FROM hms_beds b LEFT JOIN hms_wards w ON w.id = b.ward_id WHERE b.is_active = 1 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1) t

panels.title: Prescriptions vs medicines handed out
panels.description: Per hour. If the gap keeps growing, the pharmacy is falling behind.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS time, COUNT(*) AS "Prescriptions" FROM hms_prescriptions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS time, COUNT(*) AS "Medicines handed out" FROM hms_med_dispenses WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Lab tests ordered vs results released
panels.description: Per hour. If the gap keeps growing, the lab is falling behind.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS time, COUNT(*) AS "Ordered" FROM hms_investigation_order_items WHERE lab_state IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('hour', updated_at) AS time, COUNT(*) AS "Released" FROM hms_investigation_order_items WHERE lab_state = 'RELEASED' AND $__timeFilter(updated_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Labs waiting > 2h
panels.description: Lab tests ordered more than 2 hours ago with no released result.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hms_investigation_order_items WHERE lab_state IS NOT NULL AND lab_state NOT IN ('RELEASED','CANCELLED') AND created_at < now() - interval '2 hours'

panels.title: Critical labs unseen
panels.description: Dangerous results no doctor has confirmed seeing yet. Should be 0.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hms_lab_critical_tasks WHERE state = 'OPEN'

panels.title: Failed outside messages
panels.description: Messages to or from outside systems (labs, government health records) that failed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hms_interface_messages WHERE status IN ('Failed','Rejected','Unmatched') AND created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'

panels.title: Undelivered updates
panels.description: Updates (for example live screen refreshes) older than 5 minutes that were not delivered.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hms_outbox WHERE delivered_at IS NULL AND created_at < now() - interval '5 minutes'

panels.title: No discharge plan
panels.description: Patients admitted over 3 days ago with no discharge plan.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hms_admissions a WHERE a.status = 'Active' AND a.admission_date < now() - interval '3 days' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hms_discharge_plans d WHERE d.admission_id = a.id)

panels.title: Staff logged in
panels.description: People active in HMS in the last 30 minutes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM hms_sessions WHERE revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > now() AND last_seen_at > now() - interval '30 minutes'

panels.title: Live connections by role
panels.description: Screens with live updates open, by staff role.

panels.title: Requests per minute, by result
panels.description: Everything staff do in HMS, per minute.

panels.title: Why is it slow or broken? (for developers)
5 slowest pages (95% load within)
panels.description: Ranked by the time 95% of requests finish within, last 15 minutes.

panels.title: Pages that fail most (1h)
panels.description: Server errors by page, last hour. Empty is good.

panels.title: Database size
panels.description: Space the HMS database takes on disk.

targets.rawSql: SELECT pg_database_size(current_database())

panels.title: Database connections in use
panels.description: Share of allowed database connections in use.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) * 100.0 / current_setting('max_connections')::int FROM pg_stat_activity

panels.title: Slow queries running (> 5 s)
panels.description: Database queries running longer than 5 seconds right now.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'active' AND query_start < now() - interval '5 seconds' AND pid <> pg_backend_pid()

panels.title: Backup copy failures
panels.description: Times copying database changes to the backup archive failed since the database started.

targets.rawSql: SELECT failed_count FROM pg_stat_archiver

panels.title: Server memory
panels.description: Memory the HMS server uses. The container limit is 1 GB.

panels.title: Longest-running database queries
panels.description: What the database is doing right now.

targets.rawSql: SELECT pid, now() - query_start AS running_for, state, left(query, 120) AS query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state <> 'idle' AND pid <> pg_backend_pid() ORDER BY query_start LIMIT 10

panels.title: Server CPU and responsiveness
panels.description: CPU use, and how long work waits before the server picks it up (should stay under ~50 ms).
